test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Penny wise and pound foolish

options.text: Serious about wealth but never working hard
Careful in trivial matters but wasteful in large
Good at spending but bad at earning

solution:
The correct answer is **"Careful in trivial matters but wasteful in large."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"penny wise and pound foolish" **means being careful with small amounts of money but wasteful with larger amounts. (छोटी रकम के मामले में सावधान रहना लेकिन बड़ी रकम के मामले में फिजूलखर्ची करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The plans to cut funding are **penny-wise and pound-foolish**__.*
 
 
 
• It is important to be mindful of both small and large expenses in order to make wise financial decisions.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.
